name: ContMDiffFiberwiseLinear.locality_aux₁
statement: WithTop ℕ∞) (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (B × F) (B × F)) (h : ∀ p ∈ e.source, ∃ s : Set (B × F), IsOpen s ∧ p ∈ s ∧ ∃ (φ : B → F ≃L[𝕜] F) (u : Set B) (hu : IsOpen u) (hφ : ContMDiffOn IB 𝓘(𝕜, F →L[𝕜] F) n (fun x => (φ x : F →L[𝕜] F)) u) (h2φ : ContMDiffOn IB 𝓘(𝕜, F →L[𝕜] F) n (fun x => ((φ x).symm : F →L[𝕜] F)) u), (e.restr s).EqOnSource (FiberwiseLinear.openPartialHomeomorph φ hu hφ.continuousOn h2φ.continuousOn)) : ∃ U : Set B, e.source = U ×ˢ univ ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ (φ : B → F ≃L[𝕜] F) (u : Set B) (hu : IsOpen u) (_huU : u ⊆ U) (_hux : x ∈ u), ∃ (hφ : ContMDiffOn IB 𝓘(𝕜, F →L[𝕜] F) n (fun x => (φ x : F →L[𝕜] F)) u) (h2φ : ContMDiffOn IB 𝓘(𝕜, F →L[𝕜] F) n (fun x => ((φ x).symm : F →L[𝕜] F)) u), (e.restr (u ×ˢ univ)).EqOnSource (FiberwiseLinear.openPartialHomeomorph φ hu hφ.continuousOn h2φ.continuousOn)

have_tree.name: hesu
have_tree.type: ∀ p : e.source, e.source ∩ s p = u p ×ˢ univ

have_tree.name: hu'
have_tree.type: ∀ p : e.source, (p : B × F).fst ∈ u p

have_tree.name: heu
have_tree.type: ∀ p : e.source, ∀ q : B × F, q.fst ∈ u p → q ∈ e.source

name: ContMDiffFiberwiseLinear.locality_aux₂
statement: WithTop ℕ∞) (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (B × F) (B × F)) (U : Set B) (hU : e.source = U ×ˢ univ) (h : ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ (φ : B → F ≃L[𝕜] F) (u : Set B) (hu : IsOpen u) (_hUu : u ⊆ U) (_hux : x ∈ u) (hφ : ContMDiffOn IB 𝓘(𝕜, F →L[𝕜] F) n (fun x => (φ x : F →L[𝕜] F)) u) (h2φ : ContMDiffOn IB 𝓘(𝕜, F →L[𝕜] F) n (fun x => ((φ x).symm : F →L[𝕜] F)) u), (e.restr (u ×ˢ univ)).EqOnSource (FiberwiseLinear.openPartialHomeomorph φ hu hφ.continuousOn h2φ.continuousOn)) : ∃ (Φ : B → F ≃L[𝕜] F) (U : Set B) (hU₀ : IsOpen U) (hΦ : ContMDiffOn IB 𝓘(𝕜, F →L[𝕜] F) n (fun x => (Φ x : F →L[𝕜] F)) U) (h2Φ : ContMDiffOn IB 𝓘(𝕜, F →L[𝕜] F) n (fun x => ((Φ x).symm : F →L[𝕜] F)) U), e.EqOnSource (FiberwiseLinear.openPartialHomeomorph Φ hU₀ hΦ.continuousOn h2Φ.continuousOn)

have_tree.name: heuφ
have_tree.type: ∀ x : U, EqOn e (fun q => (q.1, φ x q.1 q.2)) (u x ×ˢ univ)

have_tree.name: huφ
have_tree.type: ∀ (x x' : U) (y : B), y ∈ u x → y ∈ u x' → φ x y = φ x' y
have_tree.body: fun p p' y hyp hyp' ↦ by

children.name: h1
children.type: e (y, v) = (y, φ p y v)
children.body: heuφ _ ⟨(id hyp : (y, v).fst ∈ u p), trivial⟩

children.name: h2
children.type: e (y, v) = (y, φ p' y v)
children.body: heuφ _ ⟨(id hyp' : (y, v).fst ∈ u p'), trivial⟩

have_tree.name: hΦ
have_tree.type: ∀ (y) (hy : y ∈ U), Φ y = Φ₀ ⟨y, hy⟩

have_tree.name: hΦφ
have_tree.type: ∀ x : U, ∀ y ∈ u x, Φ y = φ x y

have_tree.name: hΦ
have_tree.type: ContMDiffOn IB 𝓘(𝕜, F →L[𝕜] F) n (fun y => (Φ y : F →L[𝕜] F)) U

have_tree.name: h2Φ
have_tree.type: ContMDiffOn IB 𝓘(𝕜, F →L[𝕜] F) n (fun y => ((Φ y).symm : F →L[𝕜] F)) U
